Hi Kimberly — thanks for the note and the form. Quick answers below based on our standard process: 

1) PO: We issue our own PO once commercial terms and the DPA are executed. Our finance team will not issue a PO against a redlined contract until legal signs the DPA.
2) DPA: Yes, we require a signed DPA for any vendor processing PHI-adjacent or aggregated user data. Our legal team will review Redwood's DPA; if you have a standard template we can start there.
3) Billing: Attn: Finance Ops (finance@healthsync.com). Please include our contract number format: HS-<vendor>-<YYYYMM>.
4) Intake form: we prefer the subprocessors spreadsheet you mentioned. Attaching our completed subprocessors list and a short SOW checklist.

I've attached: HS_Subprocessors_2026.xlsx (our canonical list), and HS-SOW-draft.pdf (internal SOW checklist). Looping in our DPO for retention specifics.

If possible, let's do a 20-min sync at 1:00pm PT to go through the data-retention rows.

Hi Kimberly / team,

Quick follow-up from HealthSync DPO after reviewing your form and our subprocessors table: 

- Subprocessors: Confirmed list in HS_Subprocessors_2026.xlsx. Three third-parties (CloudServe, StoreBox, MedLogix) will each require a brief security attestation; we can accept SOC2 Type II reports or equivalent. If Redwood has a current SOC2 report, please share the link.
- Data categories: We only transfer aggregated usage metrics and hashed identifiers to Redwood; no patient-level PHI is planned. Please confirm in writing what tokenization/hashing method Redwood uses and retention of hashed identifiers.
- Retention: Our policy default is 24 months for aggregated analytics; exceptions need DPO sign-off. If Redwood proposes a shorter retention (e.g., 6–12 months), include that in the DPA Annex.
- DPA: We'll aim to sign HealthSync's DPA if the subprocessors and retention rows are approved. We expect a turnaround of ~5 business days once the DPA is in legal's hands.

Requested deliverables from Redwood: 
1) Link to current SOC2 report or attestation (URL or PDF).
2) Short paragraph describing hashing/tokenization approach and whether the identifiers are reversible.
3) Proposed retention window for hashed identifiers and any auto-delete mechanisms.

We can take the 1:00pm PT sync to walk any technical details.

Thanks,
HealthSync DPO
dpo@healthsync.com
